trigger.failure: uv pip install exceeded the native MiniSWE 30-second setup-command timeout

followup_trigger.failure: The same pre-model setup timeout recurred before the complete pytest tool wheelhouse was activated.

repair.method: Mount a read-only local wheelhouse and resolve the unchanged xjq requirements with --no-index --find-links.

evaluation_tool_wheelhouse.packages: pytest 9.1.1 plus the exact pytest-json-ctrf, pytest-json-report, pytest-timeout, jsonschema, deepdiff, lxml, and transitive wheels resolved on 2026-07-14

repair.activation_guard: Only xjq runs with all 20 exact wheel filenames present use UV_OFFLINE=1 and the read-only local wheelhouse.
repair.failed_attempt_handling: A layer directory is archived and rerun only when logs show the dependency TimeoutExpired and total_cost=0.0.

interpretation: This is an infrastructure-only exact rerun. The failed layer-4 and layer-5 attempts contain no model response and are excluded from performance analysis.
